name: Voxel Polygon Rendering
definition: A rendering technique that fills the screen with vertical bars representing heights stored in a voxel map, projecting an area of the map onto the screen as if it were a flat landscape. It solves the problem of rendering high-detail terrain with constant speed by avoiding traditional 6DOF polygon operations like rotation matrices and clipping.
summary: Voxel Polygon Rendering projects 2D voxel height maps as vertical bars using an s-buffer and local polygon data to handle floating geometry and detail variation, unlike simpler per-column depth buffer methods.
